scope: Conditional exact selected source/full-value and operation-coordinate correspondence over unbounded uninterpreted byte carriers and metadata identity/value arrays
limitations: Guard-to-SQL correspondence is inspected and separately tested, not formally refined
Exact native serialization correspondence/injectivity is an explicit premise; no real JSON codec theorem
Complete physical database inventory, data constraints, authenticated authority and registered semantics are not derived
Endpoint equality admits intervening ABA; immutable custody and complete monotone effect observer closure remain external obligations
No concurrency, liveness, aggregate resource, report persistence, promotion or publication theorem
